summary: Describes IS-IS extensions for Multiprotocol Label Switching and GMPLS traffic engineering across multiple autonomous systems. It defines how to flood traffic engineering information about inter-AS links so that inter-AS path computation can work. It does not flood information from one AS into another. It was replaced by RFC 9346.

eli5.summary: Planning a trip across several countries needs maps of the border crossings. This describes how to share information about those crossings. It has been replaced by RFC 9346.
